answer: License each newcomer as a harbor pilot for one vessel whose ember beacon carries a flicker code unique to that hull. The pilot files the beacon's reading at six waypoints down the channel, each filing checked against the mesa lookout's log before the next opens, so waypoints open one at a time and one vessel serves one pilot. A copied filing fails: no two beacons share a flicker code and the lookout's log shifts with every tide. Chartering one vessel costs $540 plus 28 pilot hours; 5,000 fakes need 5,000 vessels, $2.7 million and 140,000 hours, since no harbor charters the same hull twice.
